experimental_procedure: Method B: Finely powdered 9 (100 mg, 0.46 mmol) and hydrazine hydrate (204 μL, 4.2 mmol) were placed into a 15 mL pressure tube (Ace, with Teflon bushing and FETFE O-ring, length 10.2 cm). The reaction tube was placed in a beaker filled with vermiculite and irradiated in an ordinary domestic microwave oven (Zanussi ZM17M with rotate plate) for 6 min at 250 W. The reaction could not be performed in more than ca. 0.5 mmol scale since too high pressure develops and hydrazine hydrate escapes from the reaction vessel. The reaction mixture was cooled, the residue dissolved in methanol, and collected. experimental_procedure: Hydrazination of 3,3′-(arylmethylene)bis[2H-chromene-2,4(3H)-diones] 12a and 15 ( general procedure ). experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: Sugar Uracil-1-ylmethyl Hydrazones 4-5; General Procedure To a well stirred solution of the respective monosaccharide (2.80 mmol) and glacial AcOH (0.6 mL) in H2O (15 mL), was added the appropriate 1-acetylhydrazinouracils 3a,b (2.80 mmol) in EtOH (80 mL). The mixture was heated under reflux for 5 h (monitored by TLC) and the resulting solution was concentrated under reduced pressure and left to cool. The formed precipitate was filtered off, washed with H2O (5 mL) and EtOH (5 mL), dried and recrystallized from EtOH to give 4 and 5 in 88-95% yields. 4b, yield 92%. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: 2.3 Synthesis of N-(6-chromon-3-ylmethyleneamino)-S-{[4-aryl-5-(pyrid-4-yl)]-1,2,4-triazol-2-yl}mercaptoacetamide 1 mmol S-{[4-aryl-5-(pyrid-4-yl)]-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl}mercaptoacethydrazide (3a-3e) was dissolved in 5 mL DMF followed by the addition of 1 mmol 3-formylchromone (4a-4d) and 1 mL glacial acetic acid. The reaction mixture was magnetically stirred at room temperature for 6 h. The solution turned turbid gradually. Until large amounts of precipitate formed (If no precipitate, the reaction mixture was frozen in a refrigerator), filtered and dried. The crude product was recrystallized from DMF/EtOH/H2O. 7a, 66 %, yellowish solid m.p. 246-247 °C; 1H NMR δ: 4.47 (s, 2H, SCH2), 7.11-7.23 (m, 8H, PhH and chromon 5,7,8-H), 7.25 (s, 1H, CH=N), 7.32 (d, J = 4.9 Hz, 2H, pyridine 3,5-H), 8.54 (d, J = 4.9 Hz, 2H, pyridine 2,6-H), 8.85 (s, 1H, chromon 2-H), 11.67 (s, 1H, NH); IR (KBr) νmax: 3225 (NH), 1685 (acylhydrazon C=O), 1616 (chromon C=O), 1605 (C=N), 1600-1400 (skeletal vibration of aromatic ring) cm-1; MS m/z (%): 539 ([M + Na]+, 10), 516 (M+, 5), 267 (30), 221 (45), 156 (33), 154 (100), 128 (23), 126 (70), 119 (10). experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: 2.3 Synthesis of N-(6-chromon-3-ylmethyleneamino)-S-{[4-aryl-5-(pyrid-4-yl)]-1,2,4-triazol-2-yl}mercaptoacetamide 1 mmol S-{[4-aryl-5-(pyrid-4-yl)]-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl}mercaptoacethydrazide (3a-3e) was dissolved in 5 mL DMF followed by the addition of 1 mmol 3-formylchromone (4a-4d) and 1 mL glacial acetic acid. The reaction mixture was magnetically stirred at room temperature for 6 h. The solution turned turbid gradually. Until large amounts of precipitate formed (If no precipitate, the reaction mixture was frozen in a refrigerator), filtered and dried. The crude product was recrystallized from DMF/EtOH/H2O. 6c, 80 %, yellow solid m.p. 245-247 °C; 1H NMR δ: 2.36 (s, 3H, CH3), 2.52 (s, 3H, CH3), 4.50 (s, 2H, SCH2), 7.20 (s, 1H, CH=N), 7.23-7.28 (m, 7H, ArH and chromon 5,7,8-H), 7.34 (d, J = 4.9 Hz, 2H, pyridine 3,5-H), 8.62 (d, J = 4.9 Hz, 2H, pyridine 2,6-H), 8.84 (s, 1H, chromon 2-H), 11.57 (s, 1H, NH); IR (KBr) νmax: 3211 (NH), 1684 (acylhydrazon C=O), 1620 (chromon C=O), 1609 (C=N), 1600-1400 (skeletal vibration of aromatic ring) cm-1; MS m/z (%): 533 ([M + Na]+, 20), 281 (20), 201 (60), 134 (100), 119 (10), 106 (35).
